tests.name: intents API still auth-gated (C1 call site)

tests.reason: The gates are inert on staging until JEV_COMMUNITY_ENABLED opens the member plane (held until the TypeSafe DPA), and reaching them needs a member write (posting an intent, filing a ticket), which a read-only staging probe must not do. Decisions, gating, policy, rows without text, agreement, the C10 outcome, fire-and-forget call sites and the staging-only pins are proven by these suites.
